## Pull request overview

Fixes a console detail-page editing bug caused by passing a URL-style (prefixed) `recordId` into the modal edit form, and improves the edit modal’s usability on tablet-sized viewports by increasing its default width.

**Changes:**
- Strip the `${objectName}-` prefix from `recordId` in `RecordDetailView` before invoking `onEdit`, so the modal form receives the backend-expected ID.
- Set `modalSize: 'lg'` on the CRUD modal form schema to widen the dialog (`max-w-2xl`).
- Add a regression test covering both prefixed and non-prefixed `recordId` edit flows.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Strips object-name prefix from URL `recordId` before passing IDs to the edit handler. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Sets CRUD modal form size to `lg` to improve tablet layout. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/RecordDetailEdit.test.tsx | Adds tests verifying `recordId` prefix stripping behavior when entering edit from the detail page. |

Tests in this repo usually use a `userEvent.setup()` instance and then `await user.click(...)`. Consider switching from the static `userEvent.click(...)` call to match existing test patterns and avoid subtle async/pointer-event differences across user-event versions.
Same note here: consider using `const user = userEvent.setup(); await user.click(...)` instead of `userEvent.click(...)` directly, for consistency with other tests in apps/console.
